execution.classification: Hash-pinned source-specific NTSC callable diagnostic; not a production-auditor pass
execution.entryState: Bank $36; init A=0, X/Y=0, P=$26; retain CPU registers between callable play entries; synthetic return $0200
execution.clockBasis: MOS6567 R8 NTSC: 263 lines × 65 cycles, 1022727.14 Hz; distinct from renderer mix-chunk length
execution.limitations: No IRQ/VIC scheduling, SID reads, synthesis, envelope state, bus timestamps, VICE verification, in-game lifecycle or listening judgment. Sound-register snapshots are cross-checked separately; no source bytes, memory image or disassembly are exported.

pulseProgram.basis: Executed subtraction at $AB86; all observed carry flags set. Score consumption at $AC44/$AC46 resets only the width high byte to $04, retaining the prior low byte. No autonomous triangle PWM cycle: the note schedule resets each descending sweep.

openingPulsePitchEffect.basis: Executed voice-3 effect at $ADDD–$AE32 subtracts a 16-bit evolving step, writes frequency, resets state to $8000 after crossing its rising threshold, and raises the threshold by $80 at each reset until its high byte reaches $28. The underflowing result is written before state reset. $AD11 restores tonal voice-3 registers and volume 8.

bassArticulation.basis: For voice 2 in mode 3, the nonexpired duration path $ABBE jumps to $AC50: zero frequency, control zero, then gated waveform, every five-call score quantum. The stored D3/A2 alternation lasts ten calls per pitch, but repeated envelope starts create D-D-A-A attacks. This is a programmed rhythmic pulse rather than independent drum-voice allocation.

mechanisms.sourceSequenceBasis: At score command $80, $ABD0–$ABE1 internally calls init: zero-based mode 0 selects mode 3, modes >=3 select mode 6. $AAC7–$AAE4 explicitly installs voices 1/2 noise and zero-sustain ADSR for mode 6. Mode 6 retains their noise-score patterns but replaces voice-3 score consumption with a five-call alternating low-frequency program at $ABA2–$ABA7. This classifies source behavior without identifying its in-game purpose.

rendererCrossCheck.limits: State/prefix agreement within a bounded time window; not ordered renderer bus-write agreement or exact interrupt timing.
